source_note: 带根号的三项迭代序列极限的存在性问题
english_source_note: Existence of Limits for Three-Term Radical Iterations
callout_id: 带根号的三项迭代序列极限的存在性问题#2
statement_en: Let the sequence $\{x_n\}$ satisfy $x_1,x_2>0$ and the recurrence $$x_{n+2}:=\frac{1}{x_{n}}+\frac{2}{x_{n+1}}.$$ Prove that the limit of the sequence exists and equals $\sqrt{3}$.
key_techniques: boundedness and positivity of recursive sequences
convergence via comparison or monotonicity arguments
callout_body: 序列$\{x_n\}$满足$x_1,x_2>0$以及递归式$$x_{n+2}:=\frac{1}{x_{n}}+\frac{2}{x_{n+1}}$$证明序列的极限存在并且为$\sqrt{3}$。
